```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import json,numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Polygon
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():root=root.parent
d=json.loads((root/'context/inputs/visibilitat-costa.json').read_text())
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':13,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9.5,6.1))
fig.subplots_adjust(left=.12,right=.98,bottom=.22,top=.90)
def polygons(ax,g,fill,edge,lw):
    parts=g['coordinates'] if g['type']=='MultiPolygon' else [g['coordinates']]
    for rings in parts:
        ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.array(rings[0])[:,:2]/1000,facecolor=fill,edgecolor=edge,lw=lw))
        for hole in rings[1:]:ax.add_patch(Polygon(np.array(hole)[:,:2]/1000,facecolor='white',edgecolor=edge,lw=lw))
polygons(ax,d['sector'],'#f3ede3','#bb741d',1.4)
for tile in d['tiles']:polygons(ax,tile,'none','#b8abc9',.45)
xy=np.array(d['road']['coordinates'])[:,:2]/1000
ax.plot(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],color='#176e78',lw=1.6)
for group,colour,marker,label in [('punt','#a23557','^','T · Torxa'),
    ('carretera','#176e78','o','C · 37 posicions del recorregut'),('area','#6f51a6','s','A · 57 fragments d’àrea')]:
    pts=[s for s in d['sources'] if s['grup']==group]
    xy=np.array([[s['x'],s['y']] for s in pts])/1000
    ax.scatter(xy[:,0],xy[:,1],c=colour,marker=marker,s=95 if group=='punt' else 23,
        edgecolors='white',linewidths=.5,zorder=5 if group=='punt' else 4,label=label)
    if group=='punt':ax.annotate('T',xy=xy[0],xytext=(7,8),textcoords='offset points',weight='bold',color=colour)
ax.text(344.48,4552.60,'Vila-seca',fontsize=13)
ax.text(347.48,4550.13,'Enllaç de\nla Pineda',fontsize=13)
area=f"{d['controls']['industrial_area_m2']/10000:.2f}".replace('.',',')
ax.text(348.30,4553.02,f'Recinte petroquímic · {area} ha',ha='center',fontsize=13,color='#935c18')
ax.set(xlim=(344.3,350.0),ylim=(4549.95,4553.25),aspect='equal',xlabel='Est UTM (km)',ylabel='Nord UTM (km)')
ax.set_xticks([345,347,349]);ax.set_yticks([4550,4551,4552,4553]);ax.ticklabel_format(useOffset=False,style='plain')
ax.tick_params(labelsize=12);ax.grid(alpha=.16)
fig.legend(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels(),loc='lower center',bbox_to_anchor=(.5,.03),ncol=2,frameon=False,fontsize=13)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/visibilitat-mostreig.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
